schedule.canonical_format: UTF-8 canonical JSONL, one FormalSequenceSpec per line
schedule.e2_full_reuse: The 310-row reuse map references exact immutable E1 FULL task IDs and later task-manifest hashes; E2 FULL is not redispatched or recounted
schedule.fixed_e3_replicate_rule: FIXED_ENERGY_DEFICIT_POLICY uses replicate_index 0 once per subject-scenario unit

method_runtime.paired_initialization: RandomStream.INITIALIZATION excludes method_id and is shared at each unit-replicate-event
method_runtime.method_rng: RandomStream.ALGORITHM includes method_id and comparator_root or registered DT-RAMDE substream
method_runtime.formal_e3_planning: nominal nonlinear Hall only for every scenario
method_runtime.formal_e3_execution: R5a layer-specific observation, feasibility, execution transform and evaluation transition only

output.format: deterministic gzip UTF-8 canonical JSONL task chunks

failure_and_recovery.method_specific_failure: retain typed task failure as a formal outcome; do not retry
failure_and_recovery.infrastructure_failure: retain logs; no retry without author-approved deviation record
failure_and_recovery.resource_breach: stop new dispatch, create cooperative stop marker, preserve completed and partial immutable artifacts, mark INCOMPLETE_RESOURCE_CEILING
failure_and_recovery.global_or_sequence_hard_timeout: terminate the timed process, preserve logs, never retry automatically

persistence.control_plane: redacted counts, resource state, task IDs and hashes only
persistence.data_plane: task-local immutable raw evaluations and summaries unavailable to scheduling decisions
persistence.manifest_hashing: SHA-256 per raw chunk, task manifest and run manifest

r8_gate.required_source_identity: clean full Git commit and tree frozen in the external R8 request after R7 implementation closure
